title: PoppyClientAssertion
description: Decoded optional OAuth private_key_jwt claims. iss and sub equal client_id, aud is exactly the Company issuer, iat/exp are short-lived and jti unique. Verify signatures independently; this is never a Session JWT.

aud.description: Exact auth.issuer as a single string. The token endpoint URL and arrays are invalid.

iat.description: JWT NumericDate: seconds since the Unix epoch, including fractional seconds (RFC 7519 section 2).

exp.description: JWT NumericDate: seconds since the Unix epoch, including fractional seconds (RFC 7519 section 2).

jti.description: Unique, unguessable client-assertion identifier. A deployment may reject replay; freshness is mandatory.
